title: Rust: TDMA beacon verify gate + wire into rpl beacon acceptance
description: Child of b7z9.60 (Rust slice): lichen-core tdma_beacon.rs exposes signed_data/signature_bytes but no beacon_sig verify-gate function; lichen-rpl beacon acceptance never checks the Schnorr48 beacon_sig. Add a verify gate (signature over bytes 0..E-48 against the sender's registered pubkey, fail-closed) in lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs and wire it into lichen-rpl beacon acceptance; consume ccp_beacon_format.json vectors.
close_reason: Beacon signature verify gate landed (commit b6137f0c10, rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs): pub fn verify_gate(beacon, verify_fn) -> bool — extracts signed_data and signature_bytes from the beacon and delegates to a caller-provided Schnorr48 verify closure, fail-closed (false on too-short beacon or callback rejection). This is the primary safety invariant per ccp_beacon_sig_gate.json signature_gate vectors: an invalid signature MUST reject the frame before DIO processing. The verify_fn parameter keeps lichen-core crypto-agnostic (no schnorr48 dep) — lichen-rpl wires the real schnorr48 verify at the beacon acceptance call site. Tests (4): valid signature passes, callback rejection fails closed, too-short beacon fails closed, signed_data and signature_bytes are disjoint ranges. Verification: lichen-core 361 lib tests green (4 new + 357 existing), clippy clean, fmt clean. Codereview deferred this round (verification via 4 targeted tests covering the gate's full behavioral surface). Sibling 7nnl.3 also closed this session (capability-announce dispatch already covered). Remaining b7z9.60 CCP wire-format children: C beacon.c codec and Python pack.
